rules.description: Applicant must have received a DWP benefit decision
rules.reason_if_failed: You need a DWP decision letter to request mandatory reconsideration

rules.description: The benefit decision must be eligible for mandatory reconsideration
rules.reason_if_failed: This benefit uses a different challenge process

rules.description: Request must be within 1 month of decision letter date
rules.reason_if_failed: Your request is over 1 month late. You can still apply if you have a good reason (e.g. hospital stay, bereavement)

rules.description: Applicant must have grounds for reconsideration
rules.reason_if_failed: You must explain why you believe the decision was wrong

rules.description: The decision must be one that can be reconsidered
rules.reason_if_failed: This decision cannot be reconsidered. Your original decision letter should explain your options.

edge_cases.description: Application is over 1 month late but applicant has good reason (hospital, bereavement, etc.)
edge_cases.action: Allow application. Require explanation of late reason. DWP decision-maker will assess if reason is acceptable.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has requested written statement of reasons
edge_cases.action: Time limit becomes 14 days from written statement date, not original decision date.

edge_cases.description: Full review means benefit could decrease or stop
edge_cases.action: Mandatory warning: 'If you ask for mandatory reconsideration, someone will look at your whole benefit claim again. Your benefit may stop, stay the same, increase or decrease.' Require explicit acknowledgment.

edge_cases.description: Universal Credit claimants can request via their online journal
edge_cases.action: Offer UC journal submission as alternative to phone/letter/form.

edge_cases.description: Claimant may need additional support (mental health, learning disability, etc.)
edge_cases.action: Recommend free advice from Citizens Advice, Advicelocal, or legal adviser before proceeding.
